headline: Foundation, official-data snapshot, and Edge Lab now exist: RecordLine-1 originates lines and 26 paper picks for the full Nov 13-16 window with every row source-linked. Market-validation gates remain blocked (no odds feed, no game logs) — nothing here is a validated bet.
bullets: Scope: 31 NBA games are scheduled Nov 13-16, 2026 (9 / 5 / 9 / 8), per the official NBA games pages; the docs/ archive covers Nov 13-15 (23 games) and the Edge Lab pages cover all four slates.

Injuries: the official 11/13/26 5:15 PM ET report is transcribed on gameflow.html (attributed rows kept; 20 rows with blank team cells flagged, never inferred). The docs/ archive keeps the 12:00 PM report (75 rows) with 13 previously schedule-implied matchups now blanked (E-09).

Originated lines & picks: model RecordLine-1 (documented assumptions) produces a spread, fair moneyline and a gated paper pick for 26 of 31 games; parlays carry exact Frechet-Hoeffding joint/ rho bounds; prop combos are gated OFF until market numbers and game logs exist. Settled record and ROI are blank.
Rotation minutes and production impact are NOT computed: no verified minutes feed exists. Only officially printed statuses and officially displayed leader PPG are used; unknowns stay blank.
Strategy leaderboard: 5 strategies registered as PAPER/GATED with zero settled results; gates G1-G9 status listed on lines.html. Blocked by missing odds and game logs (Q-06 to Q-08).

Legal: Ksa states that only licensed operators (Koa licence) may offer online sports wagers in NL. Whether publishing lines, picks, or a prize leaderboard counts as offering wagers is open and needs legal review (Q-04). This is not legal advice.
Next steps (choose on the Suggestions page): automate the data refresh (S-01), harden injury parsing (S-02), set up a legal gate (S-03), collect game logs (S-04), choose an odds source (S-05).
